fields.name: children
fields.label: Extra notes (not used on the site)

fields.name: phone
fields.label: Phone (display)
fields.description: Shown as text in the header and footer, e.g. '01275 830241'.

fields.name: phone_href
fields.label: Phone (tel: link)
fields.description: The tappable link version, e.g. 'tel:+441275830241' — must start with tel: and include the country code.

fields.name: site_description
fields.label: Site meta description (SEO)
fields.description: The short summary shown in Google search results and social media link previews when a page doesn't set its own.

fields.name: hours
fields.label: Days
fields.description: Shown on the home page's opening hours table, and used as the fallback wherever a page's own Opening Hours block is left empty.

fields.name: items
fields.label: Quotes
fields.description: Shown in the home page's testimonials section, and used as the fallback wherever a page's own Testimonials block is left empty.

fields.name: plans
fields.label: Plans
fields.description: Shown on the Price List page, and used as the fallback wherever a page's own Price Table block is left empty.

fields.name: colors
fields.label: Colours
fields.description: These control the whole site's colour scheme — change one and every page using it updates automatically.

fields.name: paper
fields.label: Page background
fields.description: The main background colour behind all page content.

fields.name: paper_deep
fields.label: Page background (alternate)
fields.description: A slightly darker background, used for subtle section dividers.

fields.name: white
fields.label: Card / panel background
fields.description: Background for cards, buttons, and light-on-dark text — usually pure white.

fields.name: ink
fields.label: Body text
fields.description: The main text colour used for paragraphs and headings.

fields.name: ink_soft
fields.label: Muted text
fields.description: A lighter text colour used for secondary text like eyebrow labels and captions.

fields.name: sage
fields.label: Brand colour (light)
fields.description: A lighter shade of the main brand colour, used for section dividers.

fields.name: sage_deep
fields.label: Brand colour (primary)
fields.description: The main brand colour — used for primary buttons, links, and header/footer accents.

fields.name: sage_pale
fields.label: Brand colour (background tint)
fields.description: A very light tint of the brand colour, used as a subtle background for highlighted sections.

fields.name: brass
fields.label: Accent colour
fields.description: A warm accent colour used for hover states on light buttons and small decorative highlights.

fields.name: brass_deep
fields.label: Accent colour (hover)
fields.description: A darker shade of the accent colour, used for link hover states.

fields.name: line
fields.label: Border colour
fields.description: The colour used for thin borders and dividing lines, e.g. around cards and tables.

fields.name: typography
fields.label: Fonts
fields.description: If you change a font here, also ask your developer to update the matching Google Fonts link in the site's head.html so the new font actually loads.

fields.name: font_display
fields.label: Heading font
fields.description: Used for all headings (h1, h2, h3) — the more decorative, characterful font.

fields.name: font_body
fields.label: Body text font
fields.description: Used for paragraphs, buttons, and most other text — should be easy to read at small sizes.

fields.name: wrap_width
fields.label: Max content width
fields.description: How wide the page content can grow on large screens, e.g. '1140px'. Smaller screens are unaffected.

fields.name: radius
fields.label: Corner roundness
fields.description: How rounded corners are on buttons and cards, e.g. '6px' for subtly rounded, '0px' for sharp corners.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Site title
fields.description: Shown in the browser tab and used in page titles across the whole site.

fields.name: baseURL
fields.label: Site URL
fields.description: The live web address of the site, e.g. https://stockwood-painclinic.co.uk/ — must end in a slash.

fields.name: languageCode
fields.label: Language code
fields.description: Sets the site's language, e.g. en-gb for British English. Used in the page <html> tag and by search engines.

fields.name: enableRobotsTXT
fields.label: Allow search engines to crawl the site
fields.description: Turn off temporarily if you want to hide the site from Google while it's being worked on.

fields.name: summarylength
fields.label: Summary length (words)
fields.description: How many words to show in auto-generated summaries, e.g. blog post previews.

fields.name: favicon
fields.label: Favicon
fields.description: The small icon shown in browser tabs and bookmarks. Square PNG works best (e.g. 512x512px).

fields.name: main
fields.label: Main Menu
fields.description: Controls the navigation bar shown at the top of every page. Drag to reorder within the same level — items with a Parent set appear as a dropdown under that parent.

fields.name: pageRef
fields.label: Page
fields.description: Path to a page on this site, e.g. /booking/price-list — leave empty if using an external link below.

fields.name: url
fields.label: External link
fields.description: Use for links to other sites instead of a Page above, e.g. https://facebook.com/...

fields.name: parent
fields.label: Parent item
fields.description: To nest this under another menu item as a dropdown, type that item's Label exactly (e.g. Osteopathy). Leave empty for a top-level item.

fields.name: weight
fields.label: Order
fields.description: Lower numbers appear first among items at the same level.

description.value: References another document, used as a foreign key
